title: Build copy stays page-scoped, picture proposals reject unsuitable photos and QA memory and check history are bounded
steps: Apply page copy with a NOT_EDITABLE pair and inspect all replace calls.
Propose photos for frames with words, missing dimensions and too-small sources, with reordered inputs.
Write native article records and page text blocks, including list excerpts and repeated lines.
Fill the incremental QA cache beyond its byte/entry budget and run two host QA requests concurrently.
Read check events across turn boundaries and page through a plan's picture proposals.
Import identical photo bytes under two different frozen research asset IDs.
Send facts after a large media catalogue, deduplicate exact content segments and send an oversized complete corpus through the QA host boundary.
Render a WordPress header with two frozen logo slots and no logo in its frozen research.
Fetch a self-named image response; fulfill asynchronously, fail fulfillment and follow a five-hop redirect loop.
expect: No all:true write; NOT_EDITABLE remains an issue for the native writer.
Unsuitable or unlabelled backgrounds and upscaling are refused; output is stable and tone stays unknown until measured.
Article routes, titles and excerpts are excluded from copy packs; repeated words count once per page.
LRU limits bytes and entries, expires reads, retains no image payload and allows one host QA context at a time.
Previous turns cannot spend the current check budget or contribute returning findings; picture proposals paginate and identify unmapped targets.
Only one upload; both receipts retain the native attachment ID and each keeps its own source attribution.
Sourced hours and numeric menu prices survive without media/URL/review metadata; provenance retains every occurrence; an oversized complete corpus is explicitly refused.
Only an authorized native site title at the same brand slot is accepted; a collected logo, missing policy, changed wrapper, added slot or replacement outside the brand remains a failure.
Every fetched response body is disposed after fulfillment settles or before following a redirect; failed fulfillment and redirect exhaustion release all response bytes.
Layout-only picture proposals report identity unverified, and plan.read delivers the limitation; source associations join exact frozen image URLs without claiming identity certification.
evidence: Hano's review on PR 1739, 26 October 2026, identified cross-page copy writes and check-history overlap. Local Docker has 7.65 GiB RAM.
fence: page-scoped copy; shared deterministic picture placer; byte-bounded QA LRU and serialized browser contexts; latest-turn check history

tests: an unnamed AMBIGUOUS stays page-scoped; NOT_EDITABLE never widens a copy write
picture placer excludes unsuitable and unknown photos behind words without inventing a tone
picture placer is stable across input order and avoids repeating photos on one page
picture placer never upscales and reports missing frame dimensions and fallback candidates
copy packs leave article routes, bodies, titles and list excerpts to the native editorial writer
a repeated line on one page is counted once when identifying shared header and footer words
QA cache is bounded by bytes and entries and evicts least recently used reads
QA cache expires reads and retains no screenshot or base64 payload
host QA serializes different sites so decoded page images do not multiply across requests
buildChecks spends only the latest turn budget, ignoring an exhausted previous build turn
returning QA findings never inherit repairs or check numbers from a previous turn
plan.read pages through picture proposals and marks unknown native targets explicitly
a large gallery fetches only the next vision batch and continues after a failed batch
an aborted QA waiter opens no context and cannot let a later run pass its predecessor
an expired QA deadline aborts a hanging browser read and lets the next request run
shared photo leases are claimed only when their batch is ready to label
identical bytes from distinct research assets reuse the confirmed native attachment and retain attribution
briefOf keeps sourced hours after a large media catalogue through the host request boundary
content evidence excludes URLs, provider timestamps and review claims while retaining menu numbers and captions
exact content segment dedup preserves matcher values, order and every source occurrence
oversized complete evidence is refused by web and host instead of silently truncated
copy and collected-used share complete content evidence beyond the former 100k cutoff
a no-logo WordPress header may use its site title in the same frozen brand slot only
native text branding is authorized only by frozen WordPress research without a logo
self-named response bodies are released after fulfillment, failed fulfillment and every redirect hop
broad food labels cannot certify a named product even when one candidate fits better
media source context joins only exact frozen picture URLs and does not certify product identity
